ko.title: Technology as Mediation — 기술이 연주자의 지각·행동·판단을 조직하는 방식
ko.excerpt: v1.1 검증 반영판. Ihde·Verbeek의 기술적 매개를 L02의 신체적 편입과 L03의 행동 가능성에서 독립적으로 확장한다. 멀티스케일, 액티브 EQ·필터, Chimera의 라우팅·UI를 지각·행동·시간·참조·복구의 관계로 분석하고, 문헌 근거·설계 해석·미검증 가설을 구분한 Mediation Specification과 후속 검증 프로토콜을 제안한다.

en.title: Technology as Mediation — How technology organizes a player’s perception, action, and judgment
en.excerpt: v1.1 verification revision. Extends Ihde and Verbeek’s technological mediation beyond L02 bodily incorporation and L03 affordances. Multiscale geometry, active EQ/filters, and Chimera routing/UI are analyzed through perception, action, timing, reference, and recovery, with an evidence-separated mediation specification and proposed validation protocol.

de.title: Technology as Mediation — Wie Technik Wahrnehmung, Handeln und Urteil von Spielenden strukturiert
de.excerpt: v1.1 Prüfungsrevision. Entwickelt Ihdes und Verbeeks technische Mediation über L02s leibliche Integration und L03s Handlungsmöglichkeiten hinaus. Multiscale, aktive EQ/Filter und Chimeras Routing/UI werden anhand von Wahrnehmung, Handeln, Zeit, Referenz und Wiederherstellung analysiert. Evidenz, Entwurfsdeutung und ungeprüfte Hypothesen bleiben getrennt.
